notes.title: Hard Bullet Demo is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/7c944e672ee9e192b3c999fc3635ae4121db2a15.png[/img]
We've been working hard on this new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294760/Hard_Bullet/]VR game [b]Hard Bullet[/b][/url] and now want to gather your feedback.

Shoot, kick, destroy, jump, fly, push, blow up and — most important — have fun in this timekilling unstoppable action game!

Visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294760/Hard_Bullet/]Store Page[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gamefestival?tab=12]Steam Festival[/url] to get a Demo and start a mess!

[h1]Max Payne and F.E.A.R. -inspired gameplay[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/ff06c242693b888dc4dd10ca75d6988adc4854bc.png[/img]
We always wanted to bring classic PC blockbusters feeling to VR gaming, so expect yourself to jump, slide, do wall jumps and all this in slow motion!

Made with a special attention for dual wielding gunplay so expect various submachine guns, pistols and shotguns. You'll find classic rifles as well.

[h1]Destructions and Physics[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/b7fdf0f691b4d4fefad1099ee3b98d282b4de876.png[/img]
Inspired by genre-defining classic John Woo movies like [b]Hard Boiled, The Killer, Better Tomorrow, Hard Target[/b]

We worked out the best solutions to bring realistic physic destructions and created dozens of unique assets to fill the arenas. Classic locations to mess everything up: offices, warehouses, laboratories.


[h1]Current Demo Limitations[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/404c28e602f4aad36494bcc7113fcdc68655856c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Please, notice, this is only a Demo Beta Test and does not represent the final Hard Bullet experience.  
[*] No tutorial. Working on it.
[*] Weapons: No auto-reloading animations. No customization and limited interactions. Only a few types available.
[*] Enemy AI: Two enemy characters with a very basic intellect.
[*] Interaction: Limited character interaction. Object interaction is turned off.
[*] [b]Gore and dismemberment are turned off. Blood only.[/b]
[*] Realtime lighting and shadows are turned off.
[*] Inventory: Gun holsters are turned off.
[*] Sounds: Most of them are placeholders or not balanced yet.
[*] Grenades and explosions are turned off.
[/list]


[h1]Join our Discord[/h1]

Talk directly to the devs, share your opinion and ideas with us!
[url=https://discord.gg/QDrUWsJ]Joining Discord[/url] will help you to stay on Beta Test after the Festival.

Probably we'll turn the [b]Hard Bullet Demo[/b] off and will release an updated version after a while.
To stay on the latest Demo build you can join the Beta Test through our [url=https://discord.gg/QDrUWsJ]Discord Server[/url].

[h1]Wishlist and Follow us on Steam![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/208d04ca37e1a89ae0f5446221d35143377da41a.gif[/img]
Add Hard Bullet Steam Page to your wishlist so you'll be ready when it comes.

Steam Forums Feedback

Visit Hard Bullet Steam Discussion Forums and share your feedback there with us!


[url=https://discord.gg/QDrUWsJ]DISCORD[/url] [url=https://twitter.com/GexagonVR]TWITTER[/url] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294760/Hard_Bullet/]STEAM[/url]

notes.title: Nevrosa: Primal Ritual is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/11a83c023495bbcc46d93c5bd6ccfaec512b6b1d.jpg[/img]
Hello friends, we are happy to announce our biggest game so far — action adventure in open Misty World is launched on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070410/Nevrosa_Primal_Ritual/
[list]
[*] [b]World Exploration.[/b] Travel across vast lands covered with layers of mist, meet unbelievable plant-animal hybrids, that have been ruling this place for centuries, discover gorgeous ruins of vanished civilization and watch breathtaking scenes around you.

[*] [b]Story full of Mysteries.[/b] Story driven adventure as fearless scientist William Conway who finds an unexpected ally in a face of mystic Cursed Cube which possesses great powers.

[*] [b]Dangerous Adventure.[/b] Main resource to control everything — your own blood. Save precious drops for upgrades or load them as ammo into your faithful Vampire Gun.

[*] [b]Realistic Graphics.[/b] Building Primal Ritual exclusively for VR, we worked carefully to improve unique Nevrosa style in all the things around you. Classic horror movies and books like The Mist, The Thing, Hellraiser and even Avatar inspired the design of creatures and atmosphere.

[*] [b]Voice acting and Soundtrack.[/b] New unforgettable themes from talented composer and musician Zakhar Antonov will create a true cinematographic experience. Music reacts according to the game situation. Find out more good music tracks on the records in the Camp to get into the right mood.
[/list]
We want to thank everyone of you who liked our games and what we do in VR. Only because of our great community it is possible to produce new VR content and take you to new worlds. 

See you in the Misty World.
GexagonVR Team.

notes.title: post-Halloween Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30651528/2ec18cd776836f51d85c12b5fc00d56ac776e7bb.gif[/img]
Hello friends, we prepared a small Graphics Update to make this Halloween special in Nevrosa World.

We completely reworked Mist Spiders' models and design. Improved rigs and animations so you can spend more time with these adorable creatures.

[h1]Have fun and happy Halloween![/h1]

Other improvements:
[list]
 [*] Updated Teleport Tuning in the first two play areas to make its logic more intuitive.
 [*] When you start the game for the first time (or using Fresh Start cartridge), the whiteboard gets cleared and TV turns to off for better immersion.
 [*] Added sound for returning objects in the Apartments (starting location).
 [*] Changed terms for Return to Sender achievement — now it works as it should and not so easy to get.
 [*] New textures and correct limbs positions for the Mist Spiders.
 [*] Fixed teleport bug in Vinyl Fight. After completing the ritual, there was a chance for a blade to be spawned in a wrong place (out of play zone) — we are so sorry for this!
 [*] Fixed issue with the Pause Menu on Oculus Rift.
 [*] Fixed bug when the Volume and Music settings could return to default after loading into the Check Point.
[/list]

notes.title: Graphics & Soundtrack Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30651528/c7293f87ab95eb0cdf2ed6f7e8d9c34500dfc209.jpg[/img]

[h1]Enhanced Graphics and Performance Boost[/h1]

We reworked all the in-game textures and gained better and much clearer look for all of them. New shaders also add some magic, making beautiful lights and significantly changing the Mist World scenes.

Added a special Light Director to change lights during the game for more dramatic situations.

We added a very important option to the Main Menu which gives a significant performance boost.

There are three [b]Supersampling Presets[/b] so you can switch between them to get the best quality/performance balance for your VR setup:
[list]
[*] Normal — is the optimal setup, good for all systems.
[*] High — for systems from the Minimal System requirements.
[*] Ultra — for High-End PCs, crystal clear image. More than we used in old Nevrosa version.
[/list]

[h1]Symphonic Soundtrack by Zakhar Antonov[/h1]

[url=https://soundcloud.com/oleg-gexagon/nevrosa-escape-ost-clock-monster]Link to Soundcloud Page[/url]
[url=https://soundcloud.com/oleg-gexagon/nevrosa-escape-ost-clock-monster][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30651528/d907407cb7549354a0e25fac4a551772d485ae50.png[/img][/url]
Reworked sound director now gives all the sounds deep and realistic hearing like never before! That is a totally new sound system for Nevrosa, you've never heard so quality sounds in any VR game yet.

And now, GexagonVR Team proudly presents so long awaited Nevrosa Soundtrack!

From author Zakhar Antonov (War Thunder, Men of War 2) and with a help of Saint Petersburg Philharmonia Orchestra we bring you darkness, sorrow and the most beautiful compositions made especially for Nevrosa game.

All the game situations now are enhanced with different music tracks. The work we made with the Puzzle Table is really impressive.

Our programmer created a truly endless and unique melody that changes during the puzzle-solving process and creates an interesting story for everyone.

The Soundtrack will be available as a DLC in a month or two — Mr. Zakhar needs some time to prepare and polish them for your ears.

[h1] Other Tweaks and Fixes [/h1]

[url=steamcommunity.com/games/563550/announcements/detail/1694925518665174681]Features & Languages Announcement[/url] can give you some additional information about important features.

Here is [url=steamcommunity.com/app/563550/discussions/2/1620599015870676349]Updates section on Steam Forums[/url]  for Nevrosa owners, where you can get a full list of updates. We recommend you to visit and look through it, cause we made some change to fight mechanics as well.


In the end, we wanted to mention that work on polishing Nevrosa will continue and quality will be improved even further.

GexagonVR Team

notes.title: New Features & Languages
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30651528/a24f86f033f8a1edf639e2030140067d9881a9f3.gif[/img]
[h1]"Out-of-Bounds" Helper[/h1]
Leaving your chaperone or starting the game somewhere out of your play space could be rather difficult. Now in all such situations, this Red Helper will be shown to guide you to your play area.

[h1]Perfomance Boost[/h1]
We added a very important option to the Main Menu which gives a significant performance boost.

There are three [b]Supersampling Presets[/b] so you can switch between them to get the best quality/performance balance for your VR setup:
[list]
[*] Normal — is the optimal setup, good for all systems.
[*] High — for systems from the Minimal System requirements.
[*] Ultra — for High-End PCs, crystal clear image. More than we used in old Nevrosa version.
[/list]
You can select Minimum, Maximum and Custom graphics quality for the fast setup when standing in the Apartments scene. Usually, the best results can be achieved by tuning options by hand.

Also, we removed Mirror screen Resolution customization, cause it's almost useless, but was confusing for some users.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30651528/f60b1e607bf99be06acbf4ed5cc4540be0eb6613.jpg[/img]

[h1]Three New Languages[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30651528/189ec19fffa3aa1bed49949378a7ed400ae05cc8.jpg[/img]

Let's welcome three new languages added to Nevrosa: Portuguese, Polish and Italian, making the total number of 9! We do not plan to stop on this and will continue to add more localisations.

Please, let us know if you found any mistypes or logic errors, you can use Bugs topic in Discussions section for this.

[h1]5 New Achivements[/h1]
Added five new achievements with two of them being totally secret with a need to use some additional items to get them! Can you earn them all?

notes.title: What's coming next: Soundtrack Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30651528/d907407cb7549354a0e25fac4a551772d485ae50.png[/img]
[h1]Soundtrack[/h1]
Big Soundtrack Update, that brings unique themes to improve the gameplay and make it more cinematic as we always wanted.

As you may know from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=GexagonVR]our games[/url], we love music and always look at it as a significant part of the gaming experience. For our most important game, we chose the most impressive music — symphonic.

With a help of Saint Petersburg State Philharmonic Orchestra, we are bringing to you tunes of the Mist World and Conway's Manor New Rosa.

Click on the image below and listen to the exclusive preview on Soundcloud:

[url=https://soundcloud.com/oleg-gexagon/nevrosa-escape-ost-clock-monster]Link to Soundcloud Page[/url]
[url=https://soundcloud.com/oleg-gexagon/nevrosa-escape-ost-clock-monster][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30651528/d907407cb7549354a0e25fac4a551772d485ae50.png[/img][/url]
The soundtrack with all the tracks will be available separately as a DLC after a while.

[h1]New Sound Manager[/h1]
To say more, we reworked our sound manager, so the game now listens completely different. All sounds added depth they never had before and good balance for the best sound experience you ever had in VR.

We are really proud of all the sound work we made with Nevrosa.

[h1]When?[/h1]
So when to expect all these impressive features we've been announcing for a while?
Graphics & Soundtrack Update with lots of bugfixes is coming in 1-2 weeks from now. We are still tuning and adding minor improvements, the full list will be available in the [url=steamcommunity.com/app/563550/discussions/2/1620599015870676349/]Bugs section[/url].

If you have something to add, please feel free to contact us or leave it on [url=steamcommunity.com/app/563550/discussions/2/]Steam forums[/url].

GexagonVR Team

notes.title: Moved to December
notes.content:
Greetings everyone who was patiently waiting for the second part of [url=store.steampowered.com/app/598070/Nevrosa_Prelude/]Nevrosa game[/url].

It took almost a year for our small 4-man team to create mystery and challenging world of [url=store.steampowered.com/app/563550/Nevrosa_Escape/]Nevrosa: Escape[/url].

In the upcoming second part, you will find yourself traveling to other worlds, solve old family mysteries and puzzles, as well as intense action fights against monsters for your life.

We want to bring you this breathtaking adventure in virtual reality, focus you on details that surround and the story you are creating so we removed all the things that can distract like teleport/artificial locomotion, glowing quest tasks and annoying UI flying in front of your face.

Now we are getting to the final destination so all our ideas and solutions will be tested by you, VR enthusiasts. That is a very important moment in the life of our small indie team and we need some time to make Nevrosa more polished and narrative journey. Thank for your support during this year.

Here are those innovative features, which make Nevrosa a unique gaming experience in VR:
[list]
[*] [u]Redirect Walking/Scene adopting[/u] — you can walk free in-game bounded only by your chaperone. The game will adopt the scene in special moments so you can continue exploring its mystery.
[*] [u]Player scale changes[/u] — artifact in your hands will make you the size of a lighter so you can discover new locations and tasks.
[*] [u]Death and limbs damage[/u] — it is so annoying for us that VR games totally ignore the player’s body! In Nevrosa you can hurt yourself so do not play with sharp things.
[*] [u]No help[/u] — we do not use flying text to tell you what to do, narrator voice or flashing elements shouting “place %item_name% here you stupid”. Players will need to figure out what is happening and what to do. You will find everything you need in 1,5x2 meters area.
[/list]
We will be happy if you could support us buying [url=store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=GexagonVR]other our VR games[/url], they are quite good!

[b]tl;dr[/b]: Nevrosa: Escape release moves to mid-December. You can play free [url=store.steampowered.com/app/598070/Nevrosa_Prelude/]Nevrosa: Prelude[/url] to get some taste of what is coming.

GexagonVR Team
